notes.title: News About the game and the youtube channel
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44831876/655590d2a7c1124042244d5fd5ee25860b807a07.png[/img]

Hello friends and thank you for being here. Sorry for being away for a long time, but I've been very busy (And still I am) making games for indie studios. Although I don't have much time yet, I'm going to upload more tutorials and update the game from time to time. Because the game is NOT abandoned. What I am going to do is redo some mechanics that I think can be better implemented and more realistic. Such as the movement of the character and the combat. I don't want it to just be a generic shooter, I want it something more realistic like the character and enemies can climb objects, pass under vehicles and react better to the surroundings. I will also redo the inventory, since I want to give it a more classic and modern touch at the same time. 

Thank you and I appreciate your patience. 

Daniel Pintado Game Development

notes.title: Game News Update
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44831876/dc03d94841ebbdf1c3615faa4cd740521a56ef8c.png[/img]

Unfortunately, due to work and personal problems, I will be busy this month and part of next month. So I won't be able to update the game, but as soon as I can I'll come back even stronger and with more tutorials and updates for the game! It's just an update to let you know that the game IS NOT ABANDONED, it's just on pause right now.

Desafortunadamente, debido a problemas laborales y personales, estaré ocupado este mes y parte del próximo. Así que no podre actualizar el juego, pero tan pronto como pueda volveré aún más fuerte y con más tutoriales y mas actualizaciones para el juego! Es solo una actualización para informar que el juego NO ESTÁ ABANDONADO, simplemente está en pausa en este momento.

Sincerely, Daniel Pintado Game Development

notes.title: New demo tech version 1.6 NOW AVAILABLE!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44831876/dc03d94841ebbdf1c3615faa4cd740521a56ef8c.png[/img]

Small update fixing a few issues.

New Features and Fixes:
- Now when restart the level dont have to watch the long intro again.
- Better shadows in interiors levels.
- Now you can go back from the bank to the street again.

Planned Next Update:
- Fix sounds issues when interact with doors.
- Drop items and can pick then up again.
- More stuff in the map.
- More Map.
- More Interiors.
- Make a Game Manual with the inputs and how to play.
- More ways to interact with objects on the map.
- More ways to loot on the map.

Thank you all for trying the demo and for your reviews. I will improve the game and the demo with your advice. I will update the demo and the game every 2 weeks or so.

Sincerely Daniel Pintado Game Development
